positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Skills: Start-up Leadership · Co-creation · Start-up Ventures

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech Lead for the Game Engine Player Experience Team. We own the UI and tooling for the engine that powers League of Legends, Team Fight Tactics PC/Mobile, and more. We are expanding it to help teams deliver ever greater experiences to players.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Own the code, architecture, and standards of the League Client (Out of game experience). Work directly and indirectly with multiple teams for game systems, services, tool chains, and data pipelines to get the most value to players by making our code and ecosystem as easy to work in for all developers as possible including Art, Design, and engineering.

Currently the Tech Lead of a team that is rebuilding the build and deploy pipeline of the client as well as consolidating our source repository usage to conform to standards, in order to simplify the systems and facilitate easy local development and testing for art, design, and QA.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on the game teams developing C++ and JS for the out of game experience, C++ for the game client and server, and C++/Python for the tools. I've done UX/UI, tools and pipeline improvements, game features and gameplay engineering, and pretty much anything that's been needed or seemed like a lot of fun to give the players a great game.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as a Flash Engineer for Facebook games initiative.
